name.ja: HG 1/72 バンイップ・ブーメラン

description.ja: 「境界戦機」より、オセアニア連合が所有する無人機AMAIM(アメイン)「バンイップ・ブーメラン」をＨＧで商品化！
description.en: From "Kyoukai Senki ", the unmanned aircraft AMAIM " Bunyip Boomerang" owned by the Oceania Alliance is commercialized in HG!

description.ja: ■商品化に於いてKEN OKUYAMA DESIGNによる可動構造の検証を経て立体化されたAMAIM(アメイン)。
description.en: • AMAIM was made into a three-dimensional product after verification of its movable structure by KEN OKUYAMA DESIGN.

description.ja: ■頭部ユニットの収納、左右機関砲の展開、差し替えにより、小型アームの隠しナイフギミックなども再現可能。
description.en: • By storing the head unit, deploying the left and right cannons, and replacing them, you can also recreate the hidden knife gimmick of the small arm.

description.ja: ■哨戒状態/高機動戦闘状態/駐機状態など各形態を一部パーツの差し替えにより再現。
description.en: • Reproduce various modes such as patrol state/high mobility combat state/parked state by replacing some parts.
